nearby_not_selected.name: Resolve relative time in memory content
nearby_not_selected.description: When extracting a memory from a message that contains a relative time expression (e.g., next month, next week, tomorrow), resolve it to the absolute date using the message/session timestamp and include that absolute date in the content.
content: Applies during extraction: when a source message uses a relative time expression (next week, next month, tomorrow, in N days, etc.), resolve it to an absolute date using the message/session timestamp.
Write the resolved absolute date into the memory content itself (e.g., 'September 2023' instead of 'next month'); do not leave the relative phrase in the stored content.
Set world_start (and world_end if applicable) to the same resolved date so content and metadata are consistent.
Stop after resolving the expression; do not add extra details or searches.

content: During extraction, treat explicit sentiment phrases (e.g., 'I love her', 'I felt so proud', 'a sense of accomplishment') as memory-worthy evidence.
Create a candidate capturing the subject, the feeling, and the triggering event or relationship, preserving the specific feeling words from the source.
Do not skip reflective or nostalgic messages; stop after capturing the stated sentiment and its subject.
